previous_statement: If dim_C A=1, then ||I_A||>=1-epsilon>=1/2, so I_A is nonzero and v:C->A, lambda|->lambda I_A, is bijective.
new_statement: After shrinking the universal radius to e_0=1/4, the extended 2t-inclusion established in node 1.3 implies ||I_A||=||v(1)|| >= (1-2t)||1|| >= 1/2. Hence I_A is nonzero; if dim_C A=1, the linear map v:C->A, lambda|->lambda I_A, is bijective.
